_about: Every technical term in the course: where it is taught and its one-line meaning. scripts/lint-course.js fails if a term is used before its puzzle, if a puzzle teaches more than 6 new concepts, or if a code name, acronym or CamelCase word appears that is neither here nor in baseline. Add a term here BEFORE writing a puzzle that needs it.

baseline._about: What the learner already knows: a Kotlin developer who has built a simple Android app.

process.def: A running program with its own private memory.

memory.def: A program's data while it runs. A process can only touch its own.

kernel.def: The core of the operating system; the only code that can reach into every process.

thread.def: One worker inside a process that runs code, one instruction after another.

Activity.def: One screen of an Android app.

onCreate().def: The method that sets up an Activity. You write it; the system calls it.

system_server.def: The long-running Android process that keeps the register of every app and screen: the town hall.

Binder.def: The kernel's messenger between processes: the post office.

main thread.def: The one thread in your app that runs all screen code, one message at a time: the clerk.

UID.def: The Linux user ID Android gives each app at install: its key.

Intent.def: A letter one app sends through the system to start a screen in another (or its own) app.

permission.def: A right the system grants an app, such as using the camera.

DEX.def: The CPU-independent instructions your Kotlin compiles to, shipped in the APK.

ART.def: The Android Runtime: the translator inside each app's process that runs DEX.

machine code.def: Instructions one specific CPU can run directly.

JIT.def: Just-in-time: ART compiles hot code to machine code while the app runs.

AOT.def: Ahead-of-time: the system compiles code to machine code before it's needed, later.

profile.def: ART's notebook of which code was hot.

dex2oat.def: The system tool that compiles DEX ahead of time.

Baseline Profile.def: A profile written in advance and shipped in the APK.

page.def: A small fixed-size block of memory, the unit the kernel hands out.

fork.def: Asking the kernel for a new process that starts as a copy of an existing one.

copy-on-write.def: Shared pages are copied only when someone writes to them.

Zygote.def: The process started at boot with ART and the framework loaded; every app is forked from it.

framework.def: Android's own code that every app uses, such as the Activity class.

Application.def: Your app's one object per process, created before any screen.

Application.onCreate().def: Runs once per process, before the first screen.

ZygoteInit.main().def: Zygote's starting point in the Android source.

cold start.def: Starting an app with no process yet (warm: process alive; hot: screen alive too).

system service.def: A manager inside system_server, such as the one for screens.

ActivityTaskManagerService.def: The system service that keeps the register of screens.

startActivity().def: How your app asks the town hall to open a screen.

SystemServer.main().def: system_server's starting point in the Android source.

proxy.def: A local stand-in that looks like a service in another process.

Parcel.def: The flat envelope of bytes that carries a call's arguments between processes.

Binder thread.def: A thread each process keeps waiting for incoming Binder calls: a courier.

Binder.getCallingUid().def: Reads the UID the kernel stamped on the current call.

TransactionTooLargeException.def: Thrown when a call's data doesn't fit the ~1 MB Binder buffer.

drivers/android/binder.def: Where the Binder driver lives in the Linux source.

thread-safe.def: Safe to use from several threads at once.

MessageQueue.def: The main thread's in-tray of messages.

Looper.def: The endless loop that takes the next message and runs it.

Handler.def: The slot that drops a message into one Looper's queue.

ActivityThread.main().def: Where every app process starts; it runs the main thread's loop.

frame.def: One redraw of the screen, about every 16 ms.

jank.def: Visible stutter when frames are skipped.

ANR.def: Application Not Responding: the dialog shown when the main thread is stuck too long.
